name: Beta-blocker in asthma
pearl_text: Non-selective beta blockers such as propranolol are contraindicated in asthma because they can trigger severe bronchospasm; cardioselective agents like bisoprolol are safer if a beta blocker is essential.

name: Atrial fibrillation rate control
pearl_text: In atrial fibrillation, a lenient resting heart rate target of less than 110 bpm is as effective as strict rate control below 80 bpm in symptomatic patients with preserved left ventricular function.

name: Infective endocarditis echo
pearl_text: Transthoracic echocardiography is the first-line investigation in suspected infective endocarditis, but transoesophageal echo is required when prosthetic valves are present or TTE is technically difficult.

name: Statin myopathy risk
pearl_text: Simvastatin at 80 mg carries the highest risk of myopathy and interacts dangerously with amlodipine through CYP3A4 inhibition, raising plasma statin levels.
